license_status: The pinned comparison revision predates the upstream repository's explicit repository-level license declaration. On 2026-09-15, the upstream project published an Apache-2.0 LICENSE and its maintainer confirmed that reuse of the 5g_ansible deployment layer is welcome under Apache-2.0 with attribution and change notices retained.

reference_publication.title: Toward Real-Time RAN Observability in Open-Source 5G Systems
reference_publication.venue: 29th Conference on Innovation in Clouds, Internet and Networks (ICIN 2026)

modifications: Reorganized selected upstream Ansible content beneath deployment/.
Removed upstream roles and supporting content outside SynthRAN's supported deployment matrix.
Adapted Kubernetes, networking, OAI, Open5GS, free5GC, srsRAN, UERANSIM, reservation, radio-power, and experiment orchestration where SynthRAN requires its own integration.
N3xx physical-radio deployment is intentionally narrowed to the N300 and N320 paths; unsupported O-RAN RU preparation branches and assets are not retained.

The upstream-derived R2Lab UE connection role consumes SynthRAN's resolved network_profile_file. For Quectel MBIM UEs on SST 1 slices with a non-empty SD, SynthRAN selects the slice-qualified modem access string (<dnn>_EMBB<sd>) produced by qhat-init instead of the plain DNN so the requested S-NSSAI is preserved; final acceptance remains read-only live-state verification.
For platform=r2lab, selected cleanup, OAI N3xx IP-swap, and srsRAN N3xx deployment helper files remain byte-identical to this pinned upstream revision.
SynthRAN adds the Ambient-IoT workload, MQTT transport, collection, logging, reconciliation, and only the minimal adapter needed to run those experiments over the upstream-managed R2Lab UE interface.
comparison_note: The pinned source_commit remains authoritative for files listed in upstream_parity and for historical code comparison. The later Apache-2.0 clarification updates licensing metadata without changing the pinned source revision. Other retained deployment files are upstream-derived and may be modified by SynthRAN; no test files are retained.
